## File: facebookresearch_habitat-sim/src/deps/rapidjson/thirdparty/gtest/googlemock/scripts/gmock_doctor.py

Prompts

```
['run gmock_doctor.py to diagnose Google Mock compiler errors by piping them via stdin', 'call Diagnose() with a compiler error message string to get human-readable Google Mock diagnoses', 'review the 13 diagnoser functions like _NeedToReturnReferenceDiagnoser and _WrongMockMethodMacroDiagnoser for error pattern matching', 'summarize the _COMMON_GMOCK_SYMBOLS list containing matchers, actions, cardinalities, and sequences used by Google Mock', 'refactor the _GenericDiagnoser factory function to add new regex-based error pattern matching for custom diagnoses']
```

